source.name: NSE UDiFF F&O bhavcopy (official end-of-day contract file)

method.entry: Signal on session close; entry at the next session's official open of the chosen contract. No fill if that contract did not trade.
method.exit: Close of the 5th session held (exchange settlement price when the contract did not trade). Contracts expire at least 12 days after the signal.
method.cost_model: Slippage max(Rs 0.05, 0.5% index / 1.5% stock premium) per transaction, NSE transaction charges + 18% GST, 0.1% STT on sold premium, stamp duty, Rs 20 brokerage per order.
method.margin_model: Sell trades: return on approximate margin of 12% (index) / 20% (stock) of notional. Buy trades: return on premium paid.
method.validation: VALIDATED needs at least 60 closed trades, a date-clustered t-stat of at least 2, positive mean in both halves of history and a higher mean than the same action taken unconditionally (baseline). WEAK: positive but fails a test. NO_EDGE: mean at or below zero. INSUFFICIENT: under 30 trades.
method.no_lookahead: Signals use only data published up to the signal session; the strike and expiry are fixed from that session's chain before entry.

rules.label: Long build-up: buy call
rules.condition: Price up at least 1 sigma over 5 sessions while total futures open interest rose at least 5%.

rules.label: Short build-up: buy put
rules.condition: Price down at least 1 sigma over 5 sessions while total futures open interest rose at least 5%.

rules.label: Short covering: buy call
rules.condition: Price up at least 1 sigma over 5 sessions while total futures open interest fell at least 5%.

rules.label: Long unwinding: buy put
rules.condition: Price down at least 1 sigma over 5 sessions while total futures open interest fell at least 5%.

rules.label: Put wall support: sell put
rules.condition: Put/call OI ratio at least 1.2, largest put-OI strike within 5% below spot, no 5-session drop worse than -0.5 sigma. Sell that put.

rules.label: Call wall resistance: sell call
rules.condition: Put/call OI ratio at most 0.5, largest call-OI strike within 5% above spot, no 5-session rise above +0.5 sigma. Sell that call.

rules.label: Rich IV: sell straddle
rules.condition: ATM implied volatility in the top 20% of its own trailing year and the 5-session move within 1 sigma.

rules.label: Cheap IV: buy straddle
rules.condition: ATM implied volatility in the bottom 10% of its own trailing year.

rules.label: Baseline: buy ATM call every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

rules.label: Baseline: buy ATM put every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

rules.label: Baseline: sell 3% OTM put every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

rules.label: Baseline: sell 3% OTM call every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

rules.label: Baseline: sell ATM straddle every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

rules.label: Baseline: buy ATM straddle every 5th session
rules.condition: Unconditional comparison: every underlying, every 5th session.

limitations: End-of-day data only: no intraday prices, bid-ask spreads, order book or who initiated a trade.
Backtests use official open and close prices; real fills on illiquid stock options can be much worse than the modelled slippage.
Margins are approximations. Sold options carry losses far larger than the premium received; a single gap can erase many winning trades.
Historical edge can disappear. Rules were fixed before testing, but eight rules were tested, so one passing by chance is possible.
Jev classifies the supplied numbers only. Its confidence is not a probability of profit, and its reviews are scored only as trades mature.
Paper research. Not investment advice. No orders are placed.
